import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static long[] sequence = new long[20];

    static long recursiveSolve(long n) {
        if (n == 0) return 0;
        int pos = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 16; ++i) {
            if (sequence[i] > n) {
                pos = i;
                break;
            }
        }
        long costA = Long.MAX_VALUE, costB = Long.MAX_VALUE;
        costA = (n / sequence[pos - 1]) * (pos - 1) + recursiveSolve(n % sequence[pos - 1]);
        if (sequence[pos] - n < n)
            costB = pos + recursiveSolve(sequence[pos] - n);
        return Math.min(costA, costB);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        for (int i = 1; i <= 16; ++i)
            sequence[i] = sequence[i - 1] * 10 + 1;
        long num = scanner.nextLong();
        System.out.println(recursiveSolve(num));
        scanner.close();
    }
}
